title: Clay in Kind Hands
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who stops to wonder whose hands are holding her, and tonight Isaiah calls Heavenly Father the potter and His people the clay in His hands.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because a wonderer notices whose hands are holding her. In Wren’s world today: Wren’s playdough snake keeps breaking, and her hands go still with frustration. She watches Grandpa roll his own slowly instead of fast. Wren tries again, gentler this time, and it holds together. Just like Isaiah, who called Heavenly Father the potter and His people the clay, Wren learned that good things are made by patient hands.
